agenda_strip.lock_title: Uhlelo lomthethosisekelo — alukwazi ukuhlelwa kabusha noma lususwe · Art. II §2; §7
art4_section5_tracker.applied_body: {name} kuhlelwe kube umbhalo ongaphambili; inguqulo entsha yomthetho ishicilelwa kanti inguqulo edlule isasekhona emlandweni.
art4_section5_tracker.empty_body: Lapho inkantolo ikhipha okutholwe yinkantolo ngaphansi kwe-Art. IV §5, lo mlandeli ukhombisa okutholwe yinkantolo, isixazululo esincomo, zombili izikhathi (CLK-11 / CLK-12), kanye nezindlela zoxazululo ezintathu ngokuphila.
art4_section5_tracker.empty_title: Ayikho inselelo yomthethosisekelo evulekile ezindaweni zakho zegunya
art4_section5_tracker.enforce_body: Ukuphikelelwa kuhambisana nesimo sokugcina somthetho: ovunyelwe, ogcinwe ngokuchitha ukuvimba, noma ohlelwe inkantolo.
art4_section5_tracker.enforce_title: Isigungu esiphethe sisebenza ngomphumela — noma yikuphi okuxazululayo
art4_section5_tracker.filed_by: ngu {who} — noma yimuphi umhlali angayifayla; akukho mqondisi ngaphandle kokuhambisana nendawo yegunya.
art4_section5_tracker.finding_gate: Okutholwe yinkantolo kurekhodwa ngenkathi ukungabaza kubuyekezwa (Art. IV §5.2).
art4_section5_tracker.full_court: inkantolo ephelele — bonke amajaji {n} · CLK-16, {judge} okubhala.
art4_section5_tracker.override_gate: Ukuchitha ukuvimba ngeningi elikhethekile kuvuleka ngenkathi isikhathi sokushaya umthetho sivulekile, phakathi nesikhathi sokuvimba (Art. IV §5.4).
art4_section5_tracker.override_gloss: Iningi elikhethekile labo bonke amalungu asebenza — hhayi kuphela labo abakhona — kurekhodwa phakathi nesikhathi sokuvimba.
art4_section5_tracker.override_meter_lab: Ukuchitha ukuvimba — amavoti asekhona abo bonke asebenza
art4_section5_tracker.overruled_body: Umthetho uhlala njengoba ubhalwe; okutholwe yinkantolo, ukuvota kokuchitha ukuvimba, nesimo salungu ngalinye kusekhona irekhodi lomphakathi.
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_body: Isishayamthetho silungisa noma sise umthetho ngokuhamba komthethosivivinywa ojwayelekile phakathi nesikhathi sobulungiswa.
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_cite: kufanele kube khona phakathi kwezinsuku {days} emva kokutholwa yinkantolo · {clk} · Art. IV §5 — imibono ihlala iyikomenti ngomthetho ohlelwe
art4_section5_tracker.path_a_h: Indlela A — Isishayamthetho silungisa noma sise
art4_section5_tracker.path_b_h: Indlela B — Ukuchitha ukuvimba ngeningi elikhethekile esikhathini sokuvimba
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_body: Uma isikhathi sivaleka ngaphandle kokulungiswa noma ukuchitha ukuvimba, ubulungiswa bufaka isixazululo saso ngqo embhalweni womthetho. Umlando wezinguqulo ugcinwe.
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_cite: imibono ihlala iyikomenti ngomthetho njengoba ubhalwe noma ohlelwe · Art. IV §5
art4_section5_tracker.path_c_h: Indlela C — Isikhathi sivaleka, ubulungiswa lungisa umthetho
art4_section5_tracker.recommend_gate: Isixazululo sinikezwa ngemuva kokutholakala kokungaguquki (Art. IV §5.3).
art4_section5_tracker.recorded_notice: Kurekhodiwe irekhodi lomphakathi — ithreka ikhombisa isimo esisha.
art4_section5_tracker.remedial_bill_gate: Umthethosivivinywa wesixazululo uphothulwe ngenkathi isikhathi sokushaya umthetho sivulekile (Art. IV §5.3).
art4_section5_tracker.remedy_gate: Kutholakala lapho isikhathi sesixazululo nesikhathi sokuvimba seziphelile; kungenjalo i-CLK-11 sweep iyasisebenzisa ngokuzenzakalela (Art. IV §5.5).
art4_section5_tracker.stage_gloss: Okutholwe yinkantolo kufika esishayamthethweni njengokuqala komhlanganiso okubalulekile — izindaba zomthethosisekelo ziza phambi kwe-ajenda jikelele (WF-LEG-05).
art4_section5_tracker.window_banner_body: Isishayamthetho sinezinsuku {days} zokulungisa noma ukususa umthetho (CLK-12, kufanele kube yilu {due}) nezinsuku {vetoDays} zokuchitha ukuvimba ({clk}).
art4_section5_tracker.window_banner_titl: Isikhathi sokushaya umthetho sivulekile — ukuchitha ukuvimba kuphela ngo {date}
ballot_receipt.shown_post: . Kopiya manje — ngeke usakwazi ukusithola futhi, wena noma noma ubani.

cgc_governors.heading: Izinketho zelungu lebhodi
cgc_governors.intro: Amalungu ebhodi angenele emsebenzini ngokuphethwa kwegama isigungu esiphethe nangokuvuma kwesishayamthetho.
cgc_governors.no_appointments: Alikho ukukhethwa kwelungu lebhodi okurekhodiwe kule khasi.
cgc_governors.no_nominees: Alikho ukuphethwa kwegama okuhambisana nalokhu kule khasi. Zama ukufuna futhi.
cgc_governors.nominee_requirement: Umkhethwa kumele abe nohlangano olusebenzayo kule ndawo yegunya. Injini inika isihlalo selungu lebhodi esikhululekile.
cgc_governors.role_preview_body: Hlola izinketho zale bhodi namarekhodi okuvuma kwesishayamthetho.
cgc_governors.search_failed: Ukufuna umkhethwa akukwazanga ukulayidwa. Zama futhi.
cgc_governors.search_prompt: Funa ngegama lomphakathi, {'@'}isibonakaliso noma inkingizelo yephrofayili ukuze ukhethe umuntu.

constituent_consent_panel.body_vote_note: isishayamthetho somvoti ngasinye sivota njengomzimba — irekhodi levoti lakamamela lixhunywe ngenhla
constituent_consent_panel.both_cleared: Zombili iziningi ezikhethekile zifinyelele — isinqumo samukelwe
constituent_consent_panel.gloss: Omabili amamitha kumele adlule emkhawulweni wawo — iningi elikhethekile lesishayamthetho kanye neningi elikhethekile lezindawo zegunya zomvoti, ngalinye libalwa ngokuzimela.
constituent_consent_panel.open_both: Kuvulekile — zombili iziningi ezikhethekile kumele zidlule, ngalinye libalwa ngokuzimela
constituent_consent_panel.table_caption: Umvoti uyavuma — isishayamthetho somvoti ngasinye sivota njengeqembu

judicial_confirmations.role_preview: Ukubuka iqhaza: amalungu esishayamthetho somthombo sale nkantolo abuyekeza abanamnominethi futhi bavote ukuqinisekisa.
judicial_confirmations.title: Izicelo zobulungiswa nokunqunywa
judicial_nominations.authorization_note: Igunya livula ukuvota okuqondile kokunqunywa esishayamthethweni esidale inkantolo. Hlola iphrofayili yomuntu ngamunye ngaphambi kokuphakamisa noma ukuvota.
judicial_nominations.committee_intro: Noma yimuphi ilungu elisebenza ekomitini yobulungiswa ekhethiwe, kuhlanganise nosihlalo sayo, lingaphakamisa umuntu. Ikomiti kumele iqinisekise isicelo ngeningi elikhethekile.
judicial_nominations.constituent_intro: Ilungu elisebenza esishayamthethweni somvoti salesihlalo lingaphakamisa umuntu. Leso sishayamthetho kumele liqinisekise isicelo ngeningi elijwayelekile lalo lonke amalungu asebenza.
judicial_nominations.designate_note: Isishayamthetho esidale lokhu sinika lolu mbuzo ngesinqumo elirekhodiwe leningi elikhethekile.
judicial_nominations.designate_preview: Ukubuka komphakathi: ilungu elisebenza esishayamthethweni esidale lokhu lifayila lolu phakamiso.
judicial_nominations.no_committees: Alikho ikomiti elifanele kuleli khasi. Dala ikomiti, bese ubuyela lapha ukuze ulikhethe.
judicial_nominations.no_matches: Alikho abantu abahambisana nenkantolo kule ndawo yegunya.
judicial_nominations.no_proposals: Alukho uphakamiso lwesicelo noma lokukhetha ikomiti olufayilwe lapha.
judicial_nominations.proposal_failed: Uphakamiso alukwazanga ukufayilwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
judicial_nominations.proposal_filed: Uphakamiso lufayilwe. Landela ukuvota kwalo ngezansi.
judicial_nominations.search_failed: Ukufuna akukwazanga ukulayidwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
judicial_nominations.seat_preview: Ukubuka komphakathi: ilungu elisebenzayo lomzimba wokupheka kwalesi sihlalo lifayila isiphakamiso.
juror_screening.clean_body: Usasele ohlelweni lwama-panel. Ukukokwa kuqiniseka ngo-voir dire.
juror_screening.flagged_body: Ijaji le-panel lilandela izimpendulo ozifake isiboniso. Uma isiphambano siqiniseka, uyakhululwa ngaphandle kwesijeziso kanti ukudonswa kukhetha omunye.
juror_screening.honesty: Phendula ngokuthembeka — ukuhlunga kususa iziphambano zezinto, hhayi imibono, izinhlobo zabantu, noma ezombuso. Izimpendulo zakho ziya kwamajaji e-panel kuphela.

ownership_panel.cgc_body: Enkampani Yenhlalakahle Yomphakathi, ibhodi lelungu lebhodi limela lapho kube khona abashayeli bamalungelo — uhlangothi lomnikazi lusebenzisa uhlelo lwamalungelo kwezinye izindawo zonke.
ownership_panel.history_preserved: umlando wesakhiwo ugcinwe — irekhodi yokwengeza kuphela
ownership_panel.no_stakes: Alikho izabelo zobumnikazi ezirekhodiwe kulesi sakhiwo.
ownership_panel.rule_equal_partnership: Ushintsho lobulingani ludinga ukuvumelana kwabo bonke abalingani.
ownership_panel.rule_member_owned: Kuba ngobumnikazi bamalungu — ushintsho kulandela imithetho eyamukelwe amalungu uqobo lwalo.
ownership_panel.rule_nonprofit: Hhayi inzuzo — azikho izabelo zobumnikazi; ibhodi liphetha ngokwesivumelwano salo.
ownership_panel.rule_partnership: Ushintsho luqhubeka ngokomthetho wokuvuma wesivumelwano sobulingani.
ownership_panel.rule_stock: Ukuvuma komnikazi kubala amalungelo okuvota — irejista yamalungelo eyanquma.
ownership_panel.rule_worker_owned: Kuba ngobumnikazi basebenzi — amalungu asebenzi yiluhlangothi lomnikazi.
panel_table.caption: Imiphumela yokabela ipaneli nokuhlunga ukungqubuzana
panel_table.gloss: Ukulinganisa ukubandakanya: lapho imiphumela ibi buyinkulu, amajaji amaningi kumele alizwe — ipaneli ihlezi iyimbali ukuze kube kungekho cala elingaqedi.
